description: Arrow Protocol Reason Codes Registry. Controlled vocabulary for reason_code field on Arrow Event Objects. Entries from v1.3.1 are preserved unchanged. v1.4 adds five codes for cross-domain semantic consistency. v1.5 adds LEG range, SUPRA sanctions, and LEG subtype reason codes. v1.5.1 updates the rule-number references in LEG-* descriptions to reflect the v1.5.1 LEG renumbering (LEG-007→LEG-006, LEG-008→LEG-007, LEG-006→MSG-006). v1.6.0 aligns field-4 metadata and the LEG range reason-code identifier with the final Action name.

entries.name: Divergence Detected
entries.description: Observation sources have diverged. Two or more sources report contradictory state for the same on-chain fact.

entries.name: Observation Conditional
entries.description: Observation placed in conditional state. Confidence is bounded until condition resolves.

entries.name: Observation Halted
entries.description: Observation halted. No new events from this origin or lifecycle accepted until restored.

entries.name: Observation Degraded
entries.description: Observation degraded. Source quality or availability is reduced; Confidence ceiling is lowered.

entries.name: Observation Restored
entries.description: Observation restored to normal operating state after halt or degradation.

entries.name: Divergence Resolved
entries.description: Divergence between sources resolved. Authoritative state has been established.

entries.name: Travel Rule Acknowledged
entries.description: Travel Rule information has been transmitted and acknowledged by the receiving VASP.

entries.name: Travel Rule Rejected
entries.description: Travel Rule information was rejected by the receiving VASP. Transfer must not proceed.

entries.name: Sanctions Cleared
entries.description: Sanctions and AML screening completed. No match found. Transfer may proceed subject to other conditions.

entries.name: Sanctions Hit
entries.description: Sanctions screening returned a confirmed hit. Transfer must be blocked. Action BL is required.

entries.name: Compliance Hold
entries.description: Event placed under compliance hold pending further review. Action HL is applied.

entries.name: Compliance Released
entries.description: Compliance hold has been lifted. Event may proceed subject to other validation.

entries.name: Legal Instrument Void
entries.description: The referenced legal instrument has been voided, rescinded, or declared invalid. Any dependent events must be reversed or blocked.

entries.name: Proof Type Unbound
entries.description: A proof-backed event asserts a destination-side operational type or claim that is not bound to the source-domain classification of the proven object. The proof demonstrates existence but not semantic type. Triggered by SEM-017. Expected response: Class 3 (Restrict), Action BL, State CD or FN.

entries.name: Classification Regime Ceiling
entries.description: The applicable verification regime or bridge profile does not verify source-domain classification and therefore cannot support Confidence A or B. An event claiming A or B under a non-classification-bound regime is rejected. Triggered by SEM-017. Expected response: Class 3 (Restrict), Action BL, State FN.

entries.name: Economic Consistency Unbound
entries.description: A value-releasing or settlement-triggering event does not prove or attest that source-side value, authority, and destination-side payout are economically consistent under the applicable bridge or verification regime. Triggered by SEM-019. Expected response: Class 3 (Restrict), Action BL, State CD or FN.

entries.name: Bridge Trust Revoked
entries.description: The referenced bridge has bridge_trust_flag: 0 in the Bridge Registry. All events from this bridge are forced to Action BL regardless of other field values. This is non-overridable per BRG-001. Expected response: Class 4 (CONTROL) or Class 3 (Restrict), Action BL, State FN.

entries.name: Bridge Restoration Blocked
entries.description: A bridge restoration attempt failed because BRG-005 restoration conditions were not satisfied. The bridge cannot be restored to bridge_trust_flag: 1 until all required conditions are documented: patched/redeployed version, classification-binding mechanism, economic consistency mechanism, independent audit reference, effective deployment block/date, and restoration confidence ceiling.

entries.name: LEG Action Range Violation
entries.description: The submitted Action falls outside the permitted action range for the leg_subtype + Finality=1 combination (LEG-006 in v1.5.1; was LEG-007 in v1.5). The Finality=0 row is governed protocol-wide by SEM-013. Silent downgrade is prohibited; the submission must be re-stated. Triggered by LEG-006.

entries.name: LEG Supra Sanctions Force
entries.description: A SUPRA-origin event with reason_code=SA and Finality=1 submitted an Action other than BL. Action has been forced to BL per LEG-007 (in v1.5.1; was LEG-008 in v1.5). This is non-overridable and mirrors the BRG-001 and SAN-001 force-BL paths. Triggered by LEG-007.

entries.name: LEG Subtype Absent
entries.description: An event with origin=LEG is missing the leg_subtype field, or the value is not in the controlled vocabulary {JUD, ADM, SUPRA, LEG_TEXT, PREC}. Triggered by MSG-006 (in v1.5.1; was LEG-006 in v1.5 — reclassified as a schema constraint).

entries.name: Post-Closure Violation
entries.description: Event appended to a closed lifecycle outside the two permitted reopening shapes (Class 1 State RV reversal or Class 4 CONTROL supersession, each citing the closure event in related_events). Enforced by LFC-007 (RFC-010 Part 2, Universal Eventual Closure).

entries.name: Non-Consummation Closure
entries.description: The lifecycle's settlement window lapsed without settlement; the closure emitter of record (origin watcher) terminates it as non-consummated rather than leaving it open (RFC-010 Part 2A: abandoned lifecycles must not linger as dormant attack surface). Carried on the Class 6 closure event itself.
